svg.text: 相機硬體 ISP 創意外觀色彩轉換管線 (Hardware ISP Simulation Pipeline)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 0. 感光元件 RAW 讀出與解馬賽克 (Sensor RAW Readout & Demosaicing)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 未經非線性壓縮之場景線性輻射率 · 14-bit+ 高動態範圍 · 感光元件原生光譜色域 (Native Primaries)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 1. 線性白平衡與暗部基準 (cc1: Linear WB & Black Pedestal)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 通道獨立乘法增益 (R_gain, G_gain, B_gain) 與黑電平偏移 · 線性光空間能量守恆無偏色

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 2. 16 扇區色相調適色彩矩陣 (block13: 16-Sector Hue Matrix)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 色相圓盤 16 扇區局部 3x3 矩陣差分調整 · 原色坐標獨立旋轉 · 保護人像膚色不發黃

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 3. 129 點分段樣條色調映射 (gamma[129]: Spline Tone Curve)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 高光軟滾降 (Rolloff) · 中灰對比坡度 · 暗部微抬升 (Matte Fade) · 單調性防止階調倒轉

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 4. 5×9×9 3D 極坐標 HSV 色彩網格 (grid[3][405]: 3D Polar Lattice)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 405 節點三線性插值 (5 Luma x 9 Sat x 9 Hue) · 有界 Delta 偏移 · 賦予風格外觀專屬靈魂

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 5. 空間微對比與細節濾波 (Clarity & Detail Filtering)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 雙邊濾波 / USM 分離基底層與高頻紋理 · 局部中頻邊緣對比增強 · 模擬底片微細質感

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 6. 色域映射與直出影像編碼輸出 (Color Space Mapping & Delivery Output)

text.font-family: Virgil, "Yozai", "YozFont", "悠哉字體", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif

svg.text: 色域映射至 sRGB / Display P3 / HLG HDR · 機身硬體編碼器輸出 JPEG / HEIF (PC 模擬以 JXL 封裝)
